settings.reset_intro: These settings don't work on this computer and would keep SolidCraft from starting, so they were changed:

settings.supersampling_note: Draws the view at a higher resolution and filters it down: smoother edges, lines and grid on screens below 4K. It costs GPU time: about 2.25× the pixels at 1.5× and 4× at 2×.
settings.display_quality_note: Finer levels draw curved faces and edges smoother and take longer to mesh. Only the viewport changes, never the design or exports.
